products.title: CRGO Toroidal Core
products.subtitle: High-Efficiency Toroidal Cores for Modern Transformers
products.description: Crafted for exceptional efficiency, our Toroidal cores ensure uniform magnetic flux distribution and minimal losses. Their compact design makes them ideal for modern transformers where space, performance and reliability converge.

features.title: Uniform Magnetic Flux
features.description: The continuous, gap-free geometry of a toroid keeps the flux path tight and even — driving down stray losses and audible noise.

features.title: Compact Footprint
features.description: Higher power density than stack-built cores of equivalent rating, ideal for space-constrained equipment and portable transformers.

features.title: Reliable Performance
features.description: Wound from premium CRGO strip, annealed under inert atmosphere to lock in optimum electrical properties.

faqs.question: Which CRGO grades do you use for toroidal cores?
faqs.answer: We routinely use 23H100 (M3), 27P090 and 27HP110 (M4). Other grades from the catalogue table — including ultra-low-loss 0.23 ZDKH and HPDR — are available on request.

faqs.question: Can you build to a specific weight or OD/ID?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every core is wound to the customer's ID, OD and height. Share your size and target loss figures and we'll quote against them.

products.title: CRGO Rectangular Toroidal Core
products.subtitle: Toroidal Efficiency with Rectangular Adaptability
products.description: A unique blend of toroidal efficiency and rectangular adaptability — engineered for specialized applications. They deliver reduced magnetising current and quieter operation, a preferred choice for precision-driven industries.

features.title: Reduced Magnetising Current
features.description: Lower no-load current than equivalent stack cores, useful where reactive draw matters.

features.title: Quiet Operation
features.description: Wound construction damps mechanical buzz versus interleaved laminations.

features.title: Easy to Mount
features.description: Rectangular profile mates with conventional bobbins and clamping hardware.

products.title: CRGO Cut Toroidal Core
products.subtitle: Wound Performance with Bobbin-Friendly Assembly
products.description: Cores designed for ease of winding and assembly — cut toroidal cores simplify manufacturing without compromising electrical performance. Excellent magnetic properties combined with the flexibility for custom-built transformer solutions.

features.title: Bobbin-Friendly
features.description: Pre-cut halves slide directly onto pre-wound coils, no toroidal-winder needed.

features.title: Vacuum-Impregnated
features.description: Stabilised before cutting to maintain electrical properties across both halves.

features.title: Mirror-Polish Mating Faces
features.description: Fine polishing of the cut surface keeps the effective air gap negligible.

products.title: CRGO Gap Cores
products.subtitle: Precision Air-Gapped Cores for Reactors & Chokes
products.description: Specially designed with precise air gaps, these cores enable controlled inductance and stable performance under varying loads. Essential for reactors, chokes and specialised transformer designs that demand accuracy and adaptability.

features.title: Calibrated Air Gap
features.description: Gap dimensions held tight so inductance lands on spec — critical for line reactors and DC-blocking chokes.

features.title: Stable Under Load
features.description: Designed to resist saturation as load current swings.

features.title: Made to Drawing
features.description: Gap depth, position and core profile customised per the customer's design.

products.title: Cut Cores
products.subtitle: Toroidal Performance, E&I Convenience
products.description: Cut Cores combine the advantages of Toroidal Cores and conventional E & I laminations. Ideally suited where weight or dimensional requirements are critical and design flexibility matters. Wound from grain-oriented silicon steel strip, annealed under controlled atmosphere, vacuum-impregnated, then precision-cut and fine-polished to keep core loss low and saturation high.

features.title: Low Core Loss
features.description: Wound-strip grain alignment delivers loss figures stack cores can't match.

features.title: High Saturation Point
features.description: Polished mating faces minimise the effective gap, pushing operating flux density higher.

features.title: Flexible Geometry
features.description: Single, double and three-phase configurations to suit your transformer.

products.title: CRGO Slit Coils
products.subtitle: Precision-Slit Strips for Core Winding
products.description: Produced with high-precision slitting technology, our slit coils guarantee dimensional accuracy and consistency. A superior stacking factor ensures reliable performance in distribution and power transformers across varied load conditions.

features.title: Tight Width Tolerance
features.description: Width held to ±0.05 mm on narrow strip — see the IS 3024 tolerance chart for full range.

features.title: Clean Edges, Low Burr
features.description: Burr held to 0.018–0.035 mm depending on thickness, protecting interlaminar resistance.

features.title: Width 0–750 mm
features.description: Slit-to-order from 0–750 mm wide in thicknesses 0.20 – 0.35 mm.

products.title: CRGO Lamination Core
products.subtitle: The Heart of Reliable Transformers
products.description: Manufactured under strict tolerance control, our lamination cores deliver unmatched insulation resistance and dimensional stability. They form the heart of transformers — built for long-term reliability and consistent performance.

features.title: Insulation Resistance
features.description: Surface coating preserved through cutting and stacking, keeping interlaminar resistance high.

features.title: Built to IS 3024
features.description: Width, length, mitre, burr and edge camber all held within IS 3024 tolerance.

features.title: Any Geometry
features.description: Standard, mitred and stepped laminations cut to your drawing.

products.title: CRGO Strip Lamination
products.subtitle: Foundation of Dependable Transformer Construction
products.description: Our strip laminations offer design flexibility and efficiency, letting engineers tailor solutions for diverse transformer requirements. Low watt losses and high durability make them the foundation of dependable transformer construction.

features.title: Low Watt Loss
features.description: Available across the full CRGO grade range — from M5 down to ultra-low-loss HPDR strip.

features.title: Consistent Thickness
features.description: Strip held to ±0.005 mm on 0.20–0.27 mm thicknesses.

features.title: Annealed on Request
features.description: Stress-relieved strip available for the lowest-loss applications.

products.title: CRGO Built-Up Lamination Cores
products.subtitle: Heavy-Duty Cores for Large Transformers
products.description: Engineered for large-scale transformer applications, built-up cores deliver the mechanical strength and operational stability heavy-duty industrial environments demand — where resilience is paramount.

features.title: Mechanical Strength
features.description: Bolted frame and step-lap joints hold the stack rigid through shipping and short-circuit forces.

features.title: Step-Lap Joints
features.description: Reduces no-load loss and inrush current versus traditional butt-lap construction.

features.title: Distribution & Power
features.description: Built for both distribution transformers and larger power-class units.

products.title: Nanocrystalline Toroidal Cores
products.subtitle: Ultra-Low Loss for High-Frequency Systems
products.description: Engineered for superior magnetic performance, nanocrystalline toroidal cores deliver high permeability, low core loss and excellent frequency response. Their compact design ensures efficient energy conversion, reduced noise and stable operation across transformers, inductors and electronic components — ideal for high-frequency systems where durability and precision matter.

features.title: High Permeability
features.description: An order of magnitude higher than CRGO — keeps magnetising current minimal.

features.title: Wide Frequency Response
features.description: Stable from 50 Hz up to 100+ kHz, suiting EV chargers, SMPS and inverter chokes.

features.title: Case Options
features.description: Supplied in stainless-steel case, PBT plastic case, or paper-wrapped per application.

products.title: E Cores
products.subtitle: Three-Phase Cutting Cores
products.description: E Core is a three-phase cutting core made from various grades of high-quality CRGO steel — low iron loss and high permeability in the B-direction, available in 0.25, 0.27 and 0.30 mm strip. Backed by our cutting-edge facilities and flexible process, we produce E Cores in any geometry.

features.title: Three-Phase Geometry
features.description: E shape designed for three-leg three-phase transformer construction.

features.title: Premium CRGO
features.description: Selected from 0.25, 0.27 and 0.30 mm strip — high B-direction permeability.

features.title: Any E Profile
features.description: Window dimensions, limb width and stack height cut to your drawing.

products.title: Step Cores
products.subtitle: Stepped Wound Cores for Compact Transformers
products.description: Step Cores combine the advantages of Toroidal Cores and conventional E & I laminations — ideal where weight or dimensional limits are tight and design flexibility matters. Wound from grain-oriented silicon steel strip, annealed under controlled atmosphere, vacuum-impregnated, then precision-cut and fine-polished to deliver very low core loss and a high saturation point.

features.title: Stepped Cross-Section
features.description: Closer-to-circular cross-section maximises copper utilisation in the bobbin window.

features.title: Polished Cut Surface
features.description: Ensures very low core loss and a high saturation point.

features.title: Weight-Sensitive Designs
features.description: Best fit for compact, lightweight transformers without sacrificing efficiency.
